text:
Priya (People Ops): Hey all — quick check for tomorrow's panel (10:30am PT). Need to confirm scribe, debrief lead, and one quick rubric question before we start.
Eleni (Hiring Mgmt): I can be debrief lead. Can someone scribe?
Sam (Eng): I can take scribe for the first half, then hand off if needed.
Jordan (SRE): I'm on standby for system questions and will jump in for infra area.
Maya (Coord): Calendar invite updated with Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/999999999 — candidate pack attached. Candidate asked for a 10 min buffer after the panel for quick follow-up.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks — two quick rubric clarifications from the hiring rubric doc: 1) "System design" and "Implementation" are separate scores, do we weight them equally? 2) For "Collaboration/Communication" do we use the +/− anchors or the 1-5 scale?
Eleni (Hiring Mgmt): Use the 1-5 scale overall. For weights, follow the role spec: System design 40%, Implementation 35%, Communication 25%. I'll paste the anchors in chat in a sec.
Priya (People Ops): Copy that — can you paste anchors?
Eleni (Hiring Mgmt): Anchors:
```
5 - Clear, structured approach, tradeoffs considered, asks good follow-up Qs
3 - Some structure but misses edge cases, reasonable code ideas
1 - No clear structure, lots of guessing
```
Priya (People Ops): Cool. One more operational ask: please remember to hit the "Submit feedback" form within 30m of the panel so we can run normalization. Link in invite.
Sam (Eng): Quick note on scribe handoff — I'll add a short note at 10:50AM in the doc and @Jordan can take over if the panel runs long.
Jordan (SRE): Got it. Also flagging the candidate has a take-home due next week; please avoid spillover on question prompts about that project.
Interview Bot: Reminder: post-interview feedback window opens and will close in 24h. Automated reminder scheduled at +20m.
Maya (Coord): Accessibility note: candidate requested captions — Zoom captions are enabled.
Priya (People Ops): Great. Final checklist: Eleni = debrief lead, Sam = primary scribe, Jordan = infra backup, Maya = calendar/zoom, everyone submit feedback in 30m. Any last-minute conflicts?
Sam (Eng): All good from me.
Eleni (Hiring Mgmt): Good to go.
Jordan (SRE): All set.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll post a short post-panel normalization guide if we need to reconcile scores.
